preconditions.description: The dimensions of the grid must be within the range of 1 to 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row of the grid must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid must be either 'W' or 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of coins required to achieve the favorite coloring.
